newsitem.title: ITALY: Parmalat sees 1996 turnover as forecast.
newsitem.headline: Parmalat sees 1996 turnover as forecast.

text.p: Italian food group Parmalat said it saw its 1996 results reaching the objectives it had set both in turnover and operating profit.

In a statement Parmalat said: "The company confirms the reaching of prefixed objectives both in turnover, around 5.5 trillion lire, and in operating profit, about 480 billion lire, for the year 1996."
Earlier Parmalat shares fell around seven percent on rumours that results for last year may be weaker than expected and on talk of a capital operation.
Parmalat, in the statement, repeated an earlier comment from a spokesman that the rumours were "absolutely unfounded."
The group's shares recovered slightly in the afternoon trading session but closed down 7.25 percent on the Milan bourse at 2495 lire per share.
